outer: fixed binary [256,128] code with a supplied spectrum; independent output-coordinate permutation per outer block
permutation: transpose to 256 regions and independently permute the bits in every region
inner_variants: FieldMulStepConv(t,s): forward step is the transpose of multiplication by a uniform GF(2^(t+s)) coefficient
